senses.zh_definition: 阿莉埃蒂：玛丽·诺顿《借东西的小人》及其相关改编作品中的小人族少女角色。
senses.en_definition: The young Borrower character in Mary Norton's The Borrowers and its adaptations.
senses.ms_definition: Nama watak gadis daripada golongan manusia kecil dalam karya The Borrowers oleh Mary Norton serta adaptasinya.
senses.nuances: 人物专名，不是表示某类少女的普通名词。中文音译因发行地区而异。此处马来文释义为编辑性说明，不是 DBP 引文。[GKIDS：The Secret World of Arrietty](https://gkids.com/films/the-secret-world-of-arrietty/)

senses.zh_definition: 《借东西的小人阿莉埃蒂》：吉卜力工作室制作、米林宏昌执导的2010年动画电影，英语片名也作 The Secret World of Arrietty。
senses.en_definition: A 2010 Studio Ghibli animated film directed by Hiromasa Yonebayashi, also released as The Secret World of Arrietty.
senses.ms_definition: Judul filem animasi Studio Ghibli tahun 2010 yang diarahkan oleh Hiromasa Yonebayashi dan turut dikenali sebagai The Secret World of Arrietty.
senses.nuances: 作品名与人物名同形，使用 filem Arrietty 可明确指电影。以下搭配是自然的名称用法，不代表经过语料统计的高频排名。[Studio Ghibli：Arrietty](https://www.ghibli.jp/works/karigurashi/)

dual_scenarios.ms: Ulasan ini meneliti keberanian watak Arrietty dalam menghadapi dunia manusia.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这篇评论探讨阿莉埃蒂这一角色面对人类世界时表现出的勇气。
dual_scenarios.en: This review examines the courage Arrietty shows when confronting the human world.

etymology.historical_story: Arrietty is a character name associated with Mary Norton's The Borrowers, rather than a Malay word assembled from meaningful affixes. Studio Ghibli brought the character to animation in 2010, with Hiromasa Yonebayashi directing. The name consequently serves two connected purposes in film discussion: it identifies the tiny heroine and can also identify the film itself. [GKIDS](https://gkids.com/films/the-secret-world-of-arrietty/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Arrietty 和“一位在地板下生活的小小少女”绑定：这是角色名，也能指以她为主角的电影；不要拆成马来语词根。
